decision: No estimator selection, integration or policy qualification from this reused sample. A positive paired gain interval motivates a separately specified prospective experiment. A nonpositive/uncertain interval does not justify deploying this estimator or resampling these cases.
interpretation: Offline comparison at original factual memories. Match the existing negative/positive nearest-neighbor sets by shared query and pair-context distances. Use only their past reward/value targets. Compute predictions BEFORE joining recorded counterfactual effects. Fixed geometry reuses the incumbent bandwidth and retrieval radius; no fitting to future outcomes. Raw and matched predictions are compared on the same available cases with seed-level aggregation. The effects are finite-horizon target-agent energy changes, not unbiased Q labels or an optimal long-run policy. No new forks, live controls, learning updates, difficulty promotion or RSI claim. A live implementation would additionally price the declared two record reads per checked cross-action pair and verify checkpoints/retention before qualification.
